user.title: Connect to your EchoMuse controller
user.description: Enter the controller's base URL and an integration API key (Settings → Home Assistant Integration → Generate Key on the EchoMuse dashboard).

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http(s) URL including the port, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8768
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller with that URL and key
